steps.title: Fresh and happy
steps.text: Your pet goes home clean, comfortable and looking great.

items.title: Gentle approach for anxious dogs
items.text: Most pet owners share that the groomers handle their dogs with patience and affection, helping nervous animals feel settled and relaxed during their appointments.

items.title: Helpful and welcoming grooming staff
items.text: Clients praise Jennifer and her colleagues for their friendly demeanour, helpful guidance, and dedication to customer care. Reviewers note that the team speaks in calm, comforting tones to pets throughout bathing and clipping.

items.title: Neat haircuts and refreshing baths
items.text: Pet parents express satisfaction with the styling, hygiene baths, and nail trimming delivered by the team. Reviews highlight that dogs emerge looking tidy, cleanly brushed, and well cared for. Clients appreciate the groomers' practical advice regarding matting and coat maintenance, noting that the styling results leave their pets looking and feeling great.

faq.q: How are appointments arranged at Dee's Grooming?
faq.a: Appointments are typically scheduled over the phone with the salon team.

faq.q: Are nail trims provided for visiting pets?
faq.a: Yes, the salon performs nail trims alongside full baths and coat styling sessions.
